about: Hand-curated venue research for the Tel Aviv Festival, keyed by our venue id; festival-site's adapter maps the programme's venue labels onto these ids and room ids. Not edition-specific: a hall outlives a programme. Every figure is {value, source} with the URL it was read from, or null when nobody could cite it; coordinates also say the basis they rest on. Venue names are the festival's own Hebrew; room names are the programme's labels as written, several of them the museum exhibitions a show plays inside.

tel-aviv-museum-of-art.name: מוזיאון תל־אביב לאמנות

coordinates.basis: the article's coordinates for the museum

tel-aviv-museum-of-art.notes: The museum nights' home. The festival sells entry to its galleries on a space-available basis, and holds its open-air shows subject to the weather. Some rooms are exhibitions the show plays inside (נומה בר: מצד שני, חזון העצמות החדשות, שנת אפס) rather than named halls. No seat counts are published.

beit-ariela.name: בית אריאלה

coordinates.basis: the article's coordinates for the library

beit-ariela.notes: The Sha'ar Zion central library, next door to the museum; its shows are part of the museum night passes.

tel-aviv-performing-arts-center.name: המשכן לאמנויות הבמה

coordinates.basis: the article's coordinates for the building

tel-aviv-performing-arts-center.notes: The Golda Centre, home of the Israeli Opera and the Cameri. The programme does not name the hall the opening plays.

heichal-hatarbut.name: היכל התרבות

coordinates.basis: the article's coordinates for the building

heichal-hatarbut.notes: Heichal HaTarbut (the Charles Bronfman Auditorium), home of the Israel Philharmonic.

beit-radical.name: בית רדיקל
beit-radical.address: מרחב 3426, התחייה פינת הרצל, תל אביב-יפו

coordinates.basis: the place pin of the Google Maps link on the venue's contact page

beit-radical.notes: Radical's house in the 3426 compound, where the festival's after party plays.
